ledger.title: Phase 4 Coverage Ledger
notes: Binding-mode note: contract-derived binding-mode, row-field, and projection-determinism assertions are absorbed into the owning authoritative rows instead of creating separate helper-only completion evidence.
authoritative_execution: `backend-unit` selects authoritative `U-4-*` decoder rows through `cartulary-runner.mjs go-target backend-unit`, with target-plan selection constrained by the Phase 4 manifest and `backend_unit` execution dependency.

`backend-store` selects authoritative store-backed `U-4-*` rows through `cartulary-runner.mjs go-target backend-store`, with target-plan selection constrained by the Phase 4 manifest and `backend_store` execution dependency.
`frontend-unit` selects authoritative Phase 4 workbook component rows through the Phase 4 manifest for `frontend_unit`, while shared package tests remain support or regression coverage.

`backend-integration` selects authoritative `I-4-*` rows through `cartulary-runner.mjs go-target backend-integration`, with target-plan selection constrained by the Phase 4 manifest and `backend_integration` execution dependency.

`tools/execution_topology_manifest.json` owns browser batch grouping and renders `tools/browser_e2e_batch_manifest.json` for Phase 4: `browser-e2e-webserver-backed` carries authoritative `E-4-*` rows through duration-balanced Playwright manifest-entry shards for `test` and `check`, while direct `browser-e2e-webserver-backed` and helper-only `browser-e2e-functional` select the same rows through manifest-driven `browser_functional` shard planning. `browser-e2e-visual` carries authoritative `V-4-*` visual rows through `browser_visual`.
support_execution_extras: `apps/web/src/workbook/WorkbookShell.support.test.tsx` runs through `frontend-unit` and is forbidden from claiming `U-4-*`, `I-4-*`, or `E-4-*` identifiers.
shared_harness: | Real runtime and route helpers | `internal/modules/workbook/testsupport/scenariotest` centralizes the Postgres + object-store runtime boot path, bootstrap-admin login helpers, inventory-driven route metadata, and authoritative replay/history conformance helpers for owned Phase 4 HTTP routes, while `internal/modules/records/testsupport/storetest` owns rollback-backed entity or mention seed helpers and contract-derived field-surface helpers for store rows. |

| Cross-cutting HTTP and projection helpers | `internal/testutil/httptestx` owns success or error envelope checks, replay scaffolding, authorization re-derivation assertions, mutation attribution checks, closed-vocabulary checks, field-key conformance, and projection determinism assertions shared across the Phase 4 backend suite. |

| Entity and Timeline substrate inspection | `internal/modules/records/testsupport/assertx`, `internal/modules/timeline/testsupport/asserttest`, and Phase 4 package-local lookup helpers inspect durable mention, link, change-set, projection, and observation state that the authoritative Phase 4 rows rely on. |

| Browser helper fixtures | `apps/web/src/testing/timelineWorkbookTestSupport.ts` and `apps/web/src/workbook/timeline/services/workbookShellPhase4.ts` provide the mocked workbook row, websocket, and mention helper scaffolding used by the support-only Phase 4 workbook tests. |
support_only: `internal/modules/entities/support_integration_test.go` consumes the centralized Phase 4 route-family inventory through `TestSurfaceEnvelope`, `..._CSRFProtection`, `..._ReplayAndDivergentConflict`, `..._AuthorizationReDerivation`, `..._DefaultQueryMetaAndFieldKeyConformance`, and `..._ProjectionAndWebsocketConsequences`. These tests are diagnostic smoke coverage for mention, merge, entity-origin, indicator, Timeline, object-blob, evidence-handle, Parties, assessment, coordination, and generic workbook routes; authoritative completion claims must live in the owned `I-4-*` rows.

`apps/web/src/workbook/WorkbookShell.support.test.tsx` keeps mocked helper and component regression coverage for Phase 4 workbook chips, payload builders, inspector mention derivation, and auto-resolution notices. It remains support-only and is not completion evidence for Phase 4.
